sources.entry: Xbar - Put the output from any script or program into your macOS Menu Bar (the BitBar reboot). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/matryer/xbar)

summary.name: xbar
summary.one_liner: xbar is a macOS menu bar app that displays the output of any executable script or program, described as the reboot of BitBar.
keywords: show script output in menu bar
use_cases: Show live cryptocurrency prices in the menu bar
Display weather or time information at a glance
Monitor network or system status from the menu bar
Track cloud or AWS resources from the menu bar
Write custom scripts whose output appears in the menu bar
Browse pre-built plugins by category such as finance or dev
summary.what_it_does: xbar puts the output of any executable script or program into the macOS menu bar. It ships with a browsable library of hundreds of pre-built plugins organized by categories such as Cloud, Cryptocurrency, Dev, Finance, Network, Weather and System. Users can write their own plugins in any language. The page describes it as a reboot of BitBar. The page also asks visitors to sponsor the project on GitHub.
notable: Hundreds of pre-built plugins browsable by category
Plugins can be written in any language
caveats: Platform appears limited to macOS, as the menu bar is macOS-specific
Pricing is inferred from the awesome-mac listing (Open-Source Software) rather than stated on the page itself
